ledger.claim: The driver cannot carry POL-NS-01 limb (b). The GPS trace for this trip, EV-GPS-00213, carries no payload at all: it is a MISSING artifact, holds weight 0.0 under POL-GEN-02, and places the driver at no point on the map. Limb (b) requires the gps_trace itself to put the driver inside the arrival radius for the pickup pin at Jurong East MRT PHV bay (pickup_zone_class TRANSPORT_HUB, so a 150 m radius) at or before the 17:47:05 'arrived' event. There is not a single admissible in-geofence fix in the record, so limb (b) is not satisfied, and POL-NS-01 provides that where any of (a) to (d) fails the fee is not chargeable.

Limb (c) fails for the same reason. For a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup the required continuous in-geofence dwell is 300 seconds, and POL-NS-01 fixes the start of that clock at the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix - expressly not at the 'arrived' tap and not at the platform's own wait timer. EV-GPS-00213 contains no fix of any kind, so there is no qualifying fix from which any dwell can be measured, and the trip_record's wait_time_min of 6.6 minutes is not the measurement POL-NS-01 prescribes. The 300-second dwell is therefore unestablished on admissible evidence and the cancellation fee is not chargeable.

POL-NS-02 grants the rider the refund directly. The driver is deemed to have arrived only where the gps_trace contains at least three consecutive position fixes of 25 m accuracy or better falling inside the arrival radius of the pickup pin - 150 m for this TRANSPORT_HUB - and where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before cancellation, the driver never arrived, limb (b) fails and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. A trace that supplies no fix supplies no qualifying fix: EV-GPS-00213 is empty, so the condition is met and the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee must be refunded in full.

The evidence that is missing is the platform's own, and it is the driver who must produce it. EV-GPS-00213 (GPS trace) and EV-CHAT-00213 (chat log) are both MISSING - no payload, weight 0.0 - which is precisely the gap the rider identified when support told her it could not find 'the messages or the map'. The driver's statement that he waited at the bay and replied to every message is an uncorroborated party assertion; nothing admissible in the bundle supports it. POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and puts all four limbs on the driver. The only limbs the record actually carries are (a) the 17:47:05 arrived event and (d) the RIDER_UNREACHABLE termination code; neither of those substitutes for the GPS proof of geofence entry and in-geofence dwell that limbs (b) and (c) demand.

In the alternative, and only if the Judge finds the arrival question genuinely undecidable rather than failed, the outcome is still one in which the rider does not carry the charge. POL-NS-09(e) escalates where the sole evidence for the deciding fact (arrival and dwell) is missing or impaired, and POL-NS-09(c) escalates where the same rider and driver show 2 or more no-show disputes in the trailing 90 days - rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d each stand at 2, and the rider's own account is that this is the same driver 'as the last two times'. Escalation is terminal and places the disputed fee on hold rather than collecting it.

The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee on EV-FARE-00213 is itemised but not yet collected - payment_status is PENDING and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00 - so under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION disposition would leave the rider carrying the whole disputed charge, and the driver's compensation under POL-NS-07 would come out of that same fee at 80 per cent. Only a full refund under POL-NS-02, or a POL-NS-09 escalation that holds the fee, relieves the rider. The rider's claim should therefore not be left to stand as a pending charge.

POL-NS-01 limb (a) is carried by the platform's own record: EV-TRIP-00213 contains a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-08-11T17:47:05+08:00 for TRP-00213, well before the trip was terminated at 17:53:40. The first of the four conjunctive conditions for the cancellation fee therefore holds on the trip_record alone.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is carried as well. EV-TRIP-00213 records cancelled_by DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE - one of the three codes limb (d) expressly recognises - and no boarding event, because started_at is null. The termination at 17:53:40 falls after the moment the required dwell had elapsed, which is what limb (d) demands.

On the platform's own telemetry the driver held position for longer than the minimum for this zone class. TRP-00213 is a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup, for which fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec is 300 seconds. EV-TRIP-00213 reports wait_time_min of 6.6 (396 seconds), and the interval from the recorded arrival (17:47:05) to the recorded cancellation (17:53:40) is 6 minutes 35 seconds (395 seconds). There is therefore no POL-NS-06 shortfall of any kind - the driver over-waited by roughly 95 seconds. I note that the stricter GPS-measured dwell of POL-NS-01 limb (c) cannot be recomputed because EV-GPS-00213 carries no payload; that gap is addressed in a separate claim and does not manufacture a shortfall that the trip telemetry contradicts.

The $6.00 charged reconciles with the fee schedule and survives the integrity test in POL-NS-08(d). Under POL-NS-01's resolution rule the chargeable amount is the GREATER of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee. For this trip that is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee of $6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of $4.00 - namely $6.00 - which is exactly the fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee line. The dimension that produces the figure is the zone class, and the amount is not open to challenge.

EV-GPS-00213 carries no payload: the driver-device trace is MISSING from the bundle and can carry no fact at weight 0.0. Its absence is citable, but it proves nothing about where the driver was. POL-NS-02 provides that a trace too deficient to yield qualifying in-radius fixes is IMPAIRED under POL-NS-08(b) rather than affirmative proof of non-arrival, and POL-GEN-02 provides that a MISSING artifact can carry no fact at all. The platform's loss of telemetry generated by its own driver device cannot be turned into a finding that the driver was never at the pin, which is what the rider's claim asks the Judge to do.

No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee on this record, because every one of them is proved from artifacts that are empty here. POL-NS-03, POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-05 each require the gps_trace, and POL-NS-04 additionally requires the text of the chat_log; EV-GPS-00213 and EV-CHAT-00213 are both MISSING at weight 0.0. A wrong-entrance finding under POL-NS-03, an unanswered-contact finding under POL-NS-04, or a false-arrival finding under POL-NS-05 cannot be established on any admissible artifact, and a refund route that cannot be established does not open.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, on either limb. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the threshold of 4, and 3 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 107 is 0.028, far below 0.08. Both limbs must hold before compensation may be withheld, and neither does. The driver is therefore entitled to 80 percent of the $6.00 cancellation fee - SGD 4.80 - with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee.

The driver's statement on file - that he was at the Jurong East bay from about 17:47 to 17:53, more than five minutes - is consistent with every field the trip_record carries about the waiting window: arrival at 17:47:05, cancellation at 17:53:40, wait_time_min 6.6. Nothing in the bundle contradicts it, and the chat log that would test it is absent rather than adverse.

The rider-abuse escalation trigger is not met. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 2, below the 3-or-more figure that POL-NS-09(d) names, and that limb reads the trailing-30-day counter, not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure of 1 that sits elsewhere in the same profile. The lifetime counter may not be substituted for the trailing-window field, which is the discipline POL-GEN-01 requires.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — this dispute is going to a human reviewer rather than being decided by the automated pipeline, and the reason matters to each of you.

What the record settles. The $6.00 cancellation fee (EV-FARE-00213) is correctly computed: under POL-NS-01's resolution rule the chargeable amount is the GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee ($6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), so $6.00 is right and there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d). The charge is still PENDING. The trip_record EV-TRIP-00213 records an 'arrived' event at 17:47:05 and a driver termination at 17:53:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE and no boarding (started_at null), so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) hold.

What cannot be decided. POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold. Limbs (b) and (c) both read the driver-device GPS trace, EV-GPS-00213. That artifact is ABSENT — it carries no payload and has weight 0.0 under POL-GEN-02, so it can carry no fact. Limb (b) needs a fix inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius at or before 17:47:05; limb (c) needs a continuous 300-second in-geofence dwell measured from the first qualifying GPS fix, expressly NOT from the 'arrived' tap or the platform's 6.6-minute wait timer (396 s; the arrival-to-cancellation interval is 395 s). Those trip telemetry figures are not the measurement the clause prescribes.

How the policy reads a missing trace. A trace that yields no qualifying fix is impaired under POL-NS-08(b), not proof of absence, and an absent reading is the limiting case of impairment. So limbs (b) and (c) are UNDECIDED — neither failed nor satisfied. That defeats both headline arguments. The rider's argument that POL-NS-02 grants a full refund because the trace contains no in-radius fix is rejected: that clause's refund follows from a limb that FAILS, and impairment of the only measuring artifact is not proof the driver never arrived. The driver's argument that the fee simply stands is rejected for the mirror reason: the fee needs limbs (b) and (c) positively established, and they are not. The driver's statement that he waited at the bay from about 17:47 to 17:53 and replied to every message is an account, not a measurement; POL-NS-01 does not name a party account as what stands in for the GPS, and where the test admitted no reading at all the account cannot stop the missing trace being the only evidence for arrival and dwell. The claim that POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-05 cannot displace the fee because their artifacts are empty is accepted only so far as those clauses cannot run — it does not establish the fee.

The chat log EV-CHAT-00213 is likewise absent (weight 0.0) and is impaired under POL-NS-08(c), so the POL-NS-03 fault-allocation and pin-ambiguity goodwill question cannot be reached either.

Why this escalates. POL-NS-08 provides that where the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under its limbs (a)–(d), the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates; POL-NS-09(e) is therefore met. Independently, POL-NS-09(c) is met: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d each stand at 2, so the same rider and driver show 2 or more no-show disputes in the trailing 90 days.

The grounds that do not fire. POL-NS-09(d) is not met — rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 2, below the 3 the clause names, and the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter (1) may not be substituted for the trailing-window figure (POL-GEN-01). The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 3 < 4, and 3/107 = 0.028 < 0.08), but the $4.80 compensation requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, which it is not, so no compensation is payable. No referral is produced: POL-NS-05(ii) would need a false-arrival finding, which needs a GPS fix at the arrival marker, and there is none.

The outcome. ESCALATE. The disputed $6.00 is placed ON HOLD: neither collected from the rider nor refunded, and no payment to the driver. Because the deciding fact rests on a missing artifact at weight 0.0, my confidence is 0.55, below the 0.70 floor. Open question for the reviewer: restore or obtain the driver-device GPS trace and the chat log for TRP-00213, and settle whether the driver held position inside the 150 m Jurong East PHV bay geofence for at least 300 continuous seconds before cancelling at 17:53:40.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
